profiles.notes: Native H3 base with SageAttention, official workflows, shared Refine, and packed AV latent persistence.
LightX2V FL2VA 4-step v1.2 by default; optional 8-step/Ref2VA LoRAs on ComfyUI core H3 nodes.
Video Delta Net hybrid attention, defaulting to the released 8-step DMD stage.
Pinned Spectrum v0.2.27 or FirstBlockCache with safe/fast/aggressive/experimental presets, selected with H3_CACHE_METHOD.

Official FastH3 8-Step V2 T2VA with native VSA-H3 on ComfyUI >=0.35.0; old cores pin to v0.35.0 and reference workflows use a pinned Comfy-Org revision. Legacy community 4-step VSA remains opt-in with H3_FASTH3_VARIANT=preview4.

Native H3 base plus the MIT AntaresAlice/h3-webui Studio and GPL-3.0 Timeline Director. Timeline Director defaults to the pinned MATLOWAI fused Turbo INT8 checkpoint, with H3_TIMELINE_MODEL_VARIANT=native as a no-extra-checkpoint fallback.
